title: Scope 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA: only show when there is no active engagement or the wizard is genuinely incomplete
goal: The 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA button appears persistently on all screens including Mission Control, Findings, and Reports — even when the operator already has an active, running engagement. This creates noise and suggests something is wrong. Change the display logic so the button is: (a) visible on the Wizard screen always as primary progress CTA, (b) visible on Dashboard/Mission Control only when no engagement has a queued or running run, (c) hidden when a run is active or completed. The button lives in the topbar-nav or screen-head area; find its render condition in app.js or the shared render path and gate it on state.selectedRun being absent or in a terminal state.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Every screen shows a prominent 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA even when the operator is actively reviewing findings or running a mission. This is distracting and implies the operator needs to return to the wizard when they do not.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA always visible even during active runs — should only show when no mission is in progress.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only change the visibility condition for the wizard CTA. Do not redesign the topbar or navigation.

success_criteria: When a run is queued or running, the 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA is hidden on Mission Control, Findings, Reports, and History screens.
When no engagement exists or no runs exist, the CTA is visible on Dashboard and Wizard screen.
The CTA is always reachable via the sidebar Intake nav item regardless of its visibility in the topbar.
No regression in E2E wizard flow tests.

acceptance_criteria: With active run: CTA hidden on Mission Control, Findings, Reports.
With no engagements: CTA visible on Dashboard.
Wizard always accessible via sidebar nav.
